name: ERC-8004 — trustless agent registries
description: The canonical place in this estate where the ERC-8004 registry addresses are stated.

registries.name: Validation Registry
registries.note: Not shipped upstream. Validator registration is described in two briefs as the cleanest standing-to-revenue conversion available and is blocked on this, outside this estate. Recorded so the move is not re-proposed as merely undone.

verification_state.why: These addresses are transcribed from a research brief dated 2026-09-02, not read from chain by this lane. A contract address transcribed without an on-chain read must never be promoted to verified.
verification_state.probe_that_would_settle_it: eth_getCode against each address on Ethereum mainnet, plus a match against the published ERC-8004 reference deployment
verification_state.promote_when: an on-chain read confirms deployed bytecode at both addresses

estate_coverage.gap: cards exist; no door stated the addresses until now

what_this_does_not_establish: No agent registered in ERC-8004 is a client of the Council of AI.
An identity in a registry is not a measurement. The brief's own finding is that ERC-8004 identities exist today with zero behavioural card behind them.
No registration by the Council of AI as an ERC-8004 validator has occurred. That requires keys and is owner-gated.
The addresses above are NOT independently verified by this lane.
doctrine: Transcribed is not verified. The door says which one this is.
